The journey

The seal of the prophets

Muhammad

A man told to read, to say he is only human, and to bring one message.

Muhammad was told to read in the name of his Lord who created, the Most Generous, who taught by the pen. He was told to say he was a human being like others, and that God is one. Whoever hopes to meet their Lord is told to do good and to worship Him alone. The Quran says he was sent only as a mercy to all the worlds.

﴿بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ١ خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ٢ ٱقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْأَكْرَمُ٣ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَ بِٱلْقَلَمِ٤ عَلَّمَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ٥﴾

Translation of the meaning

Recite in the name of your Lord who created – Created man from a clinging substance. Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous - Who taught by the pen – Taught man that which he knew not.

Quran · Al-Alaq 96:1-5

﴿قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ ۖ فَمَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ لِقَآءَ رَبِّهِۦ فَلْيَعْمَلْ عَمَلًا صَـٰلِحًا وَلَا يُشْرِكْ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ أَحَدًۢا﴾

Translation of the meaning

Say, "I am only a man like you, to whom has been revealed that your god is one God. So whoever would hope for the meeting with his Lord - let him do righteous work and not associate in the worship of his Lord anyone."

Quran · Al-Kahf 18:110

﴿وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ١٠٧ قُلْ إِنَّمَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ١٠٨﴾

Translation of the meaning

And We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], except as a mercy to the worlds. Say, "It is only revealed to me that your god is but one God; so will you be Muslims [in submission to Him]?"

Quran · Al-Anbiya 21:107-108

You might ask

QuestionWhy does the Quran insist he was only a man?
AnswerSo that no one stops at him. He is told to say it himself. Worship goes to God alone, and each person may hope to meet their Lord.Quran · Al-Kahf 18:110
QuestionWas he told anything the others were not?
AnswerThe verse lists Noah, Abraham, Moses, Jesus and him under one religion, with one instruction: keep it, and do not split over it.Quran · Ash-Shura 42:13
QuestionWhere did a man with no book learn this?
AnswerThe Quran says he had not recited or written any book before it. It states that, and leaves the reader with the question: where did this come from?Quran · Al-Ankabut 29:48

The last messenger says the first thing again: your God is one, so do good.
